title: Create the Quirk Deck Grammar candidate pack
desired_change: Add fifteen typed Deck Grammar schemas, a deterministic Hand compiler, Canon Architect and BryMinn Studio Presets, eleven adversarial fixtures, a same-Goal live proof, and canonical GitHub template packs for Quirk object families.
expected_outcome: Quirk can compose task-specific Cards and Presets while proving that truth, owned-card state, and external authority remain unchanged, and can scaffold inspectable candidate packs for every supported object family.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: A malformed card system could misrepresent temporary access as ownership, turn personas into identity or authority, hide consequential information behind aesthetics, or persist a Hand without consent.

hidden_context_dependencies: The card metaphor needs typed boundaries so objects, access, ownership, quality, rarity, and authority do not collapse.
Persona Presets need executable proof that they alter approach rather than truth.
GitHub source packs need one canonical template grammar across heterogeneous Quirk object families.
Bryan must still record permitted runtime scope and the terminal human decision.
acceptance_checks: Exactly fifteen Deck Grammar schemas pass Draft 2020-12 validation.
The same Goal compiles through Canon Architect and BryMinn Studio Presets.
Truth, ownership, and authority snapshots remain identical across both Hands.
The two Hands contain different active Cards and different approach plans.
Premium access contributes no ownership or authority.
The Quirk Object Pack scaffolder supports every requested object family.
No Hand persists without consent and no candidate activates itself.
Aesthetic contracts cannot hide evidence, uncertainty, authority, risk, price, or accessibility.
A human records approve, revise, reject, or supersede.
resolution_note: Issue #26 evaluation recommends revise: retain the candidate pack, apply aesthetic-guard and scaffolder hardenings, keep candidate status, and leave final runtime-scope decision to Bryan. No reject or supersede. No merge, Canon promotion, activation, ownership mutation, or deployment is authorized by this disposition.
